name: SciTOX guidance source base example
instructions: This file is a backend source template for a source-grounded product guidance assistant.
Do not publish customer-facing claims from this file.
Replace placeholders only with owner-approved product data, labels, warnings, instructions, policies, and routing rules.
If a customer answer cannot be mapped to an approved product path, the assistant must route to human support.

source_groups.allowed_use: Product matching only after owner-approved product data is supplied.
source_groups.content: [OWNER DATA NEEDED: product names, SKUs, categories, sizes, labels, prices, ingredients, instructions, warnings, availability, and approved product-path mapping rules.]

source_groups.allowed_use: Restrict assistant outputs until legal/compliance and owner review are complete.
source_groups.content: The assistant must not provide legal advice, medical advice, diagnostic advice, test-result advice, outcome guarantees, success-rate claims, privacy/security guarantees, vendor approval claims, marketplace eligibility claims, payment-platform safety claims, or unsupported product performance claims.

source_groups.allowed_use: Escalate when approved source material does not support a clear product path.
source_groups.content: Escalate to human support when customer answers are ambiguous, sensitive, outside reviewed product mappings, request advice beyond product selection, request guaranteed outcomes, or require support details not present in the source base.

source_groups.allowed_use: Checkout routing only after payment configuration review.
source_groups.content: Authorize.net is owner-confirmed as the current processor/gateway for planning, but integration type, enabled payment methods, fraud/dispute/refund settings, and Webflow handoff remain [OWNER DATA NEEDED] and [REVIEW REQUIRED].

assistant_output_contract.recommended_product_id: null until owner-approved product mapping exists
assistant_output_contract.explanation: short source-grounded explanation, no final claim language
